_note: Synthetic, hand-written examples used while tuning rules (tuning set, 116 examples). The first 76 were written before any tuning (two labels revised after the first run: 'interested but not right now' is NOT_NOW; a bare 'I forwarded this to X' is ambiguous so it routes to REVIEW). The last 38 were an unseen hold-out whose misses drove a second round of rule changes, so they are tuning data too. See holdout-replies.json for a fresh hold-out written after that round. Two opt-out phrasings that the fresh hold-out missed ('remove this address', 'opt me out') were fixed for compliance reasons and moved here.
